Jack Heart, 2026-11-13, on the two group words: "fine for now" to: experiment is the label on runs, with no limits; cohort is "a named envelope of limits that runs are admitted under, which a later launch can add to". So the shape to design here is a cohort that later launches can join by name, not a limit attached to the experiment label. Today a cohort is created by one launch command with `parallel` and `max_usd`. Not checked: whether launching under an existing cohort name is refused or allowed now.
